section_summary.extract_value: This section describes measurement of consideration of cosmetic surgery using the Consider subscale of the ACSS (five items, 7-point Likert) and reports that an overall mean score was computed. It also notes good psychometric properties from prior work and reports Cronbach's alpha = .92 for this subscale in the present study. No sample, demographic, BMI, or survey-method details are given.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Consideration of cosmetic surgery was measured using the Consider subscale of the ACSS, which contains five items... All items were rated on a 7-point Likert-type scale... and an overall score was computed by taking the mean of the five items." "Previous work has shown that this subscale has high internal consistency... In the present study, Cronbach's alpha for this subscale was .92."
